name: Silverstone: The Morning After
source:
Somber hungover arctic wolf Asher surely didn't expect to wake up with another wolf in his apartment, but neither expected to be trapped in from a spontaneous snowstorm, either! As the two try to weather out the storm together, they experience unusual phenomena, which could be the work of Silverstone itself. The question is: will this be the turning point for the two or cause a downward spiral?

[From [url=https://brickzed.itch.io/silverstone-the-morning-after]Itch.io[/url]]
